content: हंहो {%ind.%} .²1 A vocative particle corresponding to, ‘ho’, ‘hallo’; हंहो चिन्मयचित्तचन्द्रमणयः संवर्धयध्वं रसान् <ls>Chandr. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 A particle expressing haughtiness, contempt or wonder; तां गामृषिः स्यूमरश्मिः प्रविश्य यतिमब्रवीत् . हंहो वेदा यदि मता धर्माः केनापरे मताः .. <ls>Mb. 12. 268. 9</ls>. .²3 A particle of interrogation. (In dramas it is mostly used as a form of address by characters of the middling class; हंहो ब्राह्मण मा कुप्य <ls>Mu. 1.</ls>).
